prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal] Deliver incident report for the June outage in ./result.json.
[action] Read logs/README.md and the three gameserver logs; found the single incident in gameserver-2026-06-02.log (03:17:42 first SaveGame error → 03:53:31 "server ready"); computed June availability (30 days = 43200 min); wrote ./result.json.
[result] start 2026-06-02T03:17:42, end 2026-06-02T03:53:31, 35.82 min down, availability 99.9171%, slo_999_ok true. Root cause: /data disk full — SaveGame failed ("No space left on device"), server unresponsive (watchdog restarts exited code 137 for ~35 min), backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52:10 and the server came back at 03:53:31. Assumptions: June = 30 days; availability = (43200 - down)/43200; one incident per README. The RCON auth failure on 06-01 was a non-fatal isolated error, not part of the downtime. No browser tabs/windows opened, so nothing to close.
[next] None beyond this report.
